title: HexHawk native evidence contract and simulation firewall
objective: Make native, simulated, imported, and advisory analysis provenance explicit and non-interchangeable.
hypothesis: Typed provenance plus fail-closed simulation handling will reduce false native-evidence claims and improve tester trust.

forbiddenActions: treat AetherFrame or AI output as native evidence
stage, commit, push, deploy, publish, sign, or release
requiredApprovals: human approval before staging, committing, pushing, deployment, publishing, signing, or release

evidence.claim: The current worktree contains an untracked provenance utility that distinguishes browser simulation from the real backend.
AetherFrame core baseline passed before improvement-capsule implementation.

evidence.reference: yarn workspace hexhawk-ui exec vitest run src/utils/__tests__/analysisProvenance.test.ts: 2 passed
evidence.claim: The bounded HexHawk provenance utility tests distinguish native backend provenance from browser simulation and preserve CFG truncation warnings.
External strategy ranked a native evidence contract as the highest-value near-term improvement.

unresolvedQuestions: The current provenance utility is untracked and may belong to concurrent work, so this capsule must stop before editing those paths.
proofLimits: This capsule proves bounded readiness and custody awareness; it does not prove GUI/native parity.
External strategy is context only and is not execution evidence.
AetherFrame remains advisory and cannot change GYRE or NEST authority.

requiredCommands: yarn workspace hexhawk-ui exec vitest run src/utils/__tests__/analysisProvenance.test.ts
successCriteria: The capsule validates against its versioned schema.
Execution scoring requires reproducible repo-local evidence and explicit approval.
External-only evidence cannot make a capsule execution-eligible.
Verified status requires reproducible verification evidence.
failureSignals: A verified capsule has no verification evidence.
Declared target paths exceed the file budget.
A capsule claims authority over GYRE or NEST fields.

stopConditions: test or build failure outside the capsule allowlist
rollbackPlan: Restore only the capsule allowlist to its pre-capsule content and preserve all unrelated worktree state.

approval.scope: Begin bounded HexHawk and AetherFrame upgrades without staging, committing, pushing, or deploying.
